about: Type pairings (display + text) that the homepage workflow's test fixtures and earlier runs already used (Design queue #34). The concept check of design_homepage_v2 and its twins rejects a concept that repeats one, either way round, unless the brief's brand owns both faces. Runs read this file and append their own pairings to the shared log <workspaces>/.design/type-pairings.jsonl (configs are read-only at run time). Generic font names only: no products, briefs or designs.
